rules.topic: Boss progression order (advancement parent chain + gate criteria)

chain: progress_labyrinth (eat Meef Stroganoff from the Labyrinth Minoshroom)
side_branches_from_lich: progress_yeti (kill Alpha Yeti) -> progress_glacier (kill Snow Queen)
progress_trophy_pedestal (place a trophy on the stronghold pedestal) -> progress_knights (kill ALL Phantom Knights)
progress_ur_ghast (kill Ur-Ghast; via the ghast trap)
progress_merge (hydra + ur_ghast + snow_queen all done) -> highlands
progress_troll (hold the Lamp of Cinders; via the giants/beanstalk line) -> thornlands + final plateau

rules.quote: "requirements": [["naga", "trophy", "scale", "was_in_fight"]] with 'naga' = trigger minecraft:player_killed_entity (type twilightforest:naga), 'trophy'/'scale' = inventory_changed, 'was_in_fight' = trigger twilightforest:hurt_boss
rules.topic: Progression advancements are earned per player, with personal kill credit
rules.value: For progress_naga every player must personally: land the killing blow on the Naga (player_killed_entity), have hurt the boss during the fight (hurt_boss), and hold the Naga Trophy and a Naga Scale. There is no alternative requirement set and no shared-progression config. Companion implication: on progression bosses the bot must NOT take the killing blow before the human has secured their own progression — weaken and guard, let the human finish (or the human must kill another instance of the boss elsewhere).

rules.topic: Biome locks: entering without the required advancement applies an enforcement effect

rules.quote: public static final RegistryObject<Enforcement> ACID_RAIN = ... if (player.tickCount % 5 == 0) { player.hurt(TFDamageTypes...ACID_RAIN, restriction.multiplier()) ...
rules.value: darkness/hunger/frost: the effect is re-applied every 60 ticks (amplifier from the multiplier). fire: the player is set on fire for `multiplier` seconds every 60 ticks (fire_swamp = 8 s — effectively continuous burning). acid_rain: direct damage of `multiplier` every 5 ticks while in the biome. These apply to ANY player lacking the advancement — the bot included.

rules.quote: if (isBlockProtectedFromBreaking(level, pos) && isAreaProtected(level, player, pos)) { event.setCanceled(true); }
rules.topic: Progression structures are sealed per player
rules.value: Inside a progression structure, block breaking and treasure interactions are cancelled for a player who lacks the structure's required advancement(s) (per-structure AdvancementLockConfig, e.g. the Lich Tower is configured with required advancement progress_naga). The bot cannot dig through a sealed structure for a player who has not unlocked it — and its own body is likewise blocked when IT lacks the advancement.

rules.quote: criteria: 'hydra': tick, 'snow_queen': tick, 'ur_ghast': tick (all progression checks); parent: twilightforest:progress_lich
rules.value: progress_merge completes when the Hydra, Ur-Ghast and Snow Queen progressions are all held. Only then does the acid rain stop in the Highlands.

progress_troll completes when the player holds the Lamp of Cinders (from the Troll Cave vault under the beanstalk/giants line). It stops the acid rain in the Thornlands and on the Final Plateau. The Final Castle on the plateau is the (unfinished) end of the current progression.
